messages.author: ca0c16e8660126b0
messages.subject: blavFitIndices returns nothing
parts:
Hi all,

  I just started working with blavaan this afternoon and I'm really appreciating it! However, I am having a hard time getting fit indices. When I run:

ML <- blavFitIndices(fit, baseline.model = fit0)

... I get nothing. Nothing in the console nor in the Data list. I set up the null model and it converges without error – although, I admit, I'm unsure if it's setup correctly.

  Any suggestions?



Eric Andrews, MA, LPC
Ph.D. Student, Cognition and Neural Systems
Neuroscience of Emotion & Thought (NET) Lab
Department of Psychology, University of Arizona

messages.subject: Re: blavFitIndices returns nothing
parts:
Eric

I am not clear where the error is. Up to that line the console will not present anything, you need to ask for the summary of it
summary(ML)

If this doesnt work, please share the full syntax and any error message
